purpose: Defines the design (How) of the ADR writer feature: a write-adr entry SKILL, an isolated adr-writer custom Agent, and an adr_exchange.py handoff script, implementing the requirements of REQ-030.
summary: Overview of three components: write-adr inheriting SKILL, adr-writer custom Agent, adr_exchange.py script
Architecture diagram and responsibilities of each component and its write targets
Design decisions: why an Agent, why a SKILL entry, one ADR file per feature, body written by the Agent, verdict-only return
adr_exchange.py spec: identifiers, target file resolution, subcommands open/request-path/finish/check, request fields, validation, exit codes
adr-writer Agent spec: tools, write boundary, required reading, input, output, handling per kind (approval-record, judgement, update)
write-adr SKILL spec: arguments and the eight-step flow from output resolution to finishing
Normative documents to change: adr_principles_spec, adr_usage_spec, adr_format, doc_structure_format
Use cases and sequence diagram with error flows
Existing components reused and test design: unit tests, lint, contract checks, evaluation tests
tasks: Implementing or modifying the adr-writer Agent
Reviewing ADR writer design and implementation
Designing the ADR normative documents and format
Writing tests and lint for the ADR writer
title: DES-085 ADR ライター 設計書
